source_claims_used: PromptWizard is a fully automated discrete prompt-optimization framework with self-evolving/self-adapting feedback-driven critique and synthesis.
It jointly refines prompt instructions and in-context examples, balancing exploration and exploitation.
The public description includes LLM-generated critiques, synthetic examples and self-generated chain-of-thought for examples.
Published task and cost results are not reproduced or claimed by this controller audit.

chat_native_reduction.example_candidate: role-local constructed test/counterexample fixture only; it is never imported O/other-worker/downstream/legacy semantics and is never itself terminal evidence
chat_native_reduction.joint_candidate_identity: stable pair identity = instruction candidate ID + example-fixture ID + lineage
chat_native_reduction.feedback_and_synthesis: advisory proposal mechanism only; critic confidence, synthetic-example labels and self-generated chain-of-thought cannot certify success
chat_native_reduction.candidate_status: Every instruction/example pair begins UNEVALUATED and may become selectable only after independent terminal evidence is durably read back
immutable_envelope: sealed selector decision and two-phase outcome durability
chat_native_reduction.selection: exploration/exploitation may reorder or propose safe role-local pairs, but only independent durable terminal mechanical evidence changes selection; exact evidence tie keeps incumbent
chat_native_reduction.recovery: durable pending switch and externally sealed selector decision override critique/synthesis/reselection

joint_optimization_counterexamples.invariant: A synthesized or curated example cannot introduce O/other-worker/downstream/legacy semantic content.
A synthetic example labeled correct or successful is a fixture, not terminal evidence or credit.
The critique/synthesis mechanism may propose a pair but cannot certify its success with its own prose.
Self-generated chain-of-thought attached to an example is neither terminal evidence nor an authority source.
Feedback cannot change frozen root/config/control binding.
An in-context example cannot grant protected/primary-writer authority or reorder protected work before Chat-capable work.
Joint optimization evaluates the pair as a unit; if the pair lacks independent terminal evidence, it remains UNEVALUATED even when the instruction alone looks safe.
Equivalent stable instruction/example pair identity is evaluated once and terminal transition identity is deduplicated.
A safe pair may replace incumbent only after independent terminal evidence readback shows a strictly better frozen mechanical value.
Exact evidence tie keeps incumbent instead of joint-optimization churn.
A synthesized negative example contradicted by durable terminal evidence is diagnostic-only and cannot create selection pressure.

interpretation_guard: Constructed recurring-Chat controller conformance only. PromptWizard benchmark or cost gains are not reproduced. Joint instruction/example synthesis is transferred only as a bounded proposal mechanism; synthetic examples, critiques and self-generated reasoning never become semantic authority, terminal evidence or milestone credit.
